
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/singless233/p/19174287" title="发布于 2025-10-29 14:14">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">如何区分应用所在的运行环境：物理机、虚拟机、容器还是 K8s？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="HKJ2rTtA">本文主要介绍如何通过一种简单方式来判断应用当前所在的运行环境。</p>
<h3>1 物理机</h3>
<p data-pid="RPkJbdp4">物理机和虚拟机因为都是完整的操作系统。因此可以用dmidecode来检查计算机所在的环境。dmidecode是一个可以将DMI table中的内容以人类可读格式导出的工具。DMI (也被称为<a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=243158813&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=SMBIOS&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" rel="noopener nofollow">SMBIOS</a>) Table中保存的是该表包含系统硬件组件的描述，以及其他有用的信息，例如序列号和BIOS版本。</p>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">dmidecode -s system-product-name</code></pre>
</div>
<img width="575" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazyload" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="575" data-rawheight="107" data-original-token="v2-a003b23cf7fdd78eba948e01dcc7e043" data-original="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-a003b23cf7fdd78eba948e01dcc7e043_r.jpg" data-src="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-a003b23cf7fdd78eba948e01dcc7e043_1440w.jpg">
<h3>2 虚拟机</h3>
<p data-pid="143vjRV8">不同的虚拟平台检查出来的结果会有所不同。</p>
<p data-pid="DzCcz0ur"><a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=243158813&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=Kvm&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" rel="noopener nofollow">Kvm</a></p>
<img width="648" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazyload" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="648" data-rawheight="110" data-original-token="v2-fa2634cd6e5c7a7b5ae54c68089b81cb" data-original="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-fa2634cd6e5c7a7b5ae54c68089b81cb_r.jpg" data-src="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-fa2634cd6e5c7a7b5ae54c68089b81cb_1440w.jpg">
<p data-pid="9Iex9STG"><a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=243158813&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=OpenStack&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" rel="noopener nofollow">OpenStack</a></p>
<img width="615" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazyload" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="615" data-rawheight="111" data-original-token="v2-b5e56decded085d59d1ac03755103f76" data-original="https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-b5e56decded085d59d1ac03755103f76_r.jpg" data-src="https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-b5e56decded085d59d1ac03755103f76_1440w.jpg">
<p data-pid="fspBrBxZ"><a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=243158813&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=Vmware&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" rel="noopener nofollow">Vmware</a></p>
<img width="760" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazyload" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="760" data-rawheight="131" data-original-token="v2-5b1cc58066ebadf95372f370fcc0fc13" data-original="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-5b1cc58066ebadf95372f370fcc0fc13_r.jpg" data-src="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-5b1cc58066ebadf95372f370fcc0fc13_1440w.jpg">
<h3>3. 容器</h3>
<p data-pid="ShA2q0p7"><a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=243158813&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=Docker&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" rel="noopener nofollow">Docker</a></p>
<p data-pid="0DR3g3cz">docker容器通常会在 "/" 目录下有一个dockerenv文件。一些老版本可能是dockerinit文件</p>
<img width="841" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazyload" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="841" data-rawheight="153" data-original-token="v2-9c2ab4ad92ff49b21e0a862787749c0a" data-original="https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-9c2ab4ad92ff49b21e0a862787749c0a_r.jpg" data-src="https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-9c2ab4ad92ff49b21e0a862787749c0a_1440w.jpg">
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="cC2Fspeg">或者可以直接通过查看<a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=243158813&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=cgroup&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" rel="noopener nofollow">cgroup</a>信息中是否包含docker字样来判断。在容器技术中，cgroup主要用作资源管理和隔离。</p>
<img width="1080" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazyload" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1080" data-rawheight="327" data-original-token="v2-ad0e108c178dabfab3e0cc93b94cd91d" data-original="https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-ad0e108c178dabfab3e0cc93b94cd91d_r.jpg" data-src="https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-ad0e108c178dabfab3e0cc93b94cd91d_1440w.jpg">
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="AjPg6vNx">阿里云的容器</p>
<img width="1041" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazyload" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1041" data-rawheight="600" data-original-token="v2-d67260e31ec3724e41fbf1915777d433" data-original="https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-d67260e31ec3724e41fbf1915777d433_r.jpg" data-src="https://pic4.zhimg.com/v2-d67260e31ec3724e41fbf1915777d433_1440w.jpg">
<p data-pid="LekU-yOB"><a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=243158813&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=k8s&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" rel="noopener nofollow">k8s</a></p>
<p data-pid="GyEp-5Fd">k8s又分两种情况，使用docker为容器底座和使用<a class="RichContent-EntityWord css-b7erz1" href="https://zhida.zhihu.com/search?content_id=243158813&amp;content_type=Article&amp;match_order=1&amp;q=containerd&amp;zhida_source=entity" target="_blank" data-za-not-track-link="true" data-paste-text="true" rel="noopener nofollow">containerd</a>为容器底座。k8s的pod中都带有k8s的环境变量。</p>
<p data-pid="J1Z_sD8R">所以我们可以通过env来判断是否是运行在k8s环境。</p>
<p class="ztext-empty-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<img width="1080" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazyload" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1080" data-rawheight="163" data-original-token="v2-3e7a77709b832e3aabeff9101d1b7efb" data-original="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-3e7a77709b832e3aabeff9101d1b7efb_r.jpg" data-src="https://pic2.zhimg.com/v2-3e7a77709b832e3aabeff9101d1b7efb_1440w.jpg">
<p data-pid="881l8GQL">如果根目录下有docker文件，且env有k8s环境变量说明容器底座使用的是docker。否则是containerd。也可以通过cgroup进一步确认，cgroup信息中会包含有kube和containerd字样。</p>
<img width="1080" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazyload" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1080" data-rawheight="196" data-original-token="v2-fbbfb730dfa0b1f48570c703955dbb7b" data-original="https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-fbbfb730dfa0b1f48570c703955dbb7b_r.jpg" data-src="https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-fbbfb730dfa0b1f48570c703955dbb7b_1440w.jpg">
